verdict.rationale: Qodo's docs say it automatically reviews every pull request and lets you control when reviews run (qodo-docs-1, qodo-docs-26). Findings can be dismissed or resolved, and a history of findings is kept (qodo-docs-3, qodo-docs-6, qodo-docs-15), which hints at some state carried across reviews. However, nothing explicitly says new commits trigger an incremental re-review or that earlier comments are tracked as fixed rather than repeated. Missing for 10: documented re-review triggered by a push, incremental diff-only review of new commits, marking prior findings as fixed, suppression of duplicate comments, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
